organisms.text: Drafts the cm has prepared and that are waiting for your review, and requests for new agents you are still describing
All company agents and drafts: name, who the agent talks to, whether it is on, who is responsible, and for drafts whether they are preparing, ready or refused with the reason
Create a new virtual employee: describe the agent and its functions in plain words and send it to the cm
What happened to each request: sent, draft ready with suggested tools turned on, or refused with the reason
The ready draft: who the new agent is, what it will do and who it talks to
Tools suggested for the draft, grouped by module and subject, with a checkbox to turn each one on or off
Try the draft: pick a person or role to see what it can do, or type a sentence to see how it reads it
Activate the agent or discard the draft

tree.label: Agent
tree.text: Pick an agent to see what it is, what it did, and to work with it.

organisms.text: What the agent is, who it talks to, on whose behalf it acts and who is responsible for it
How the agent behaves today, in plain language
What do you want to change? Tell the agent in plain words how it should behave differently
History of changes: who, when and a one-line summary, with undo on each change
Tools by module, subject and action with readable names and descriptions, when each was chosen and whether it was removed from the release; tick to turn an action on or off for this agent
Tools turned on automatically: suggested by a ready draft or chosen after a new release, never overriding your own choices
The @name people use to call the agent in a chat, on or off, and the responsible person; you are told if another active agent already uses the name
The agent's limits as the cm lists them
What the agent did, newest first: when, how long, cost, the actions and their results, whether a person took over, who called it and the link to the conversation
What it can: see which tools the agent can or cannot use and why, for yourself or, as admin, for a chosen person or role
What it understands: type a sentence and see whether it asks for an action, which part of the tree and which actions
How this agent behaves for you when it acts on your behalf
Change how the agent behaves for you
Your past changes to this agent's conduct: when and a one-line summary
Choose a person from the organization, with their login e-mail
Tools that person may not use through any agent: tool, where it sits, when it was marked and whether it left the release; tick or untick each one
Which agents use each tool
All actions of the app modules and the cm tools, by module and subject, with removed tools marked
Catalog updates after a new module or release: tools added and tools marked removed

placements.reason: The agents list is the collection the admin administers and offers the + to create a new virtual employee.
Reviewing, simulating, activating or discarding acts on the draft the screen shows.
The change box and undo act on the behavior already shown for the chosen agent.
The checkboxes act on the tool tree shown for the chosen agent.
Saving the name, on/off and responsible person acts on the configuration on screen.
The simulation runs on the agent already chosen.
Restricting a person's tools starts from a person, not from an agent, so it has its own menu item.
The member reads what the chosen agent did on its activity screen.
The member simulates the agent already chosen, as themselves.
The member changes their own conduct shown for the chosen agent and sees its history there.
